name: CoDriver
author: Viktor Trncik
description: AI desktop automation — screenshots, clicks, typing, and OCR
detailedDescription:
CoDriver is an MCP server that enables AI agents to control desktop applications. It captures screenshots, reads accessibility trees, performs OCR, and injects mouse/keyboard input — providing full "computer use" capabilities via the Model Context Protocol.

**Supported platforms:** macOS and Windows.
**Requirements:** Node.js 20+.

tools.description: Read accessibility tree with reference IDs

tools.name: desktop_find
tools.description: Search UI elements by name, role, or value

tools.name: desktop_launch
tools.description: Launch, quit, or check app status

name: Kubernetes MCP
author: Containers
description: Native Kubernetes & OpenShift cluster management via MCP
detailedDescription:
A Model Context Protocol server that provides native Go-based interaction with Kubernetes and OpenShift clusters. Interfaces directly with the Kubernetes API server (not a kubectl wrapper) for high-performance, low-latency operations across single or multiple clusters.

**Features:** Multi-cluster support, Helm charts, KubeVirt VMs, Kiali service mesh, port forwarding, pod exec, log streaming, and full resource CRUD.
**Requirements:** Node.js 18+ (via npx) or native binary. A valid kubeconfig.

tools.description: Execute a command in a container

tools.description: Get a specific resource by name

tools.name: resources_create_or_update
tools.description: Create or update a resource from YAML/JSON

name: Playwright MCP
author: Microsoft
description: Browser automation via structured accessibility snapshots
detailedDescription:
A Model Context Protocol server from Microsoft that provides browser automation capabilities using Playwright. It enables LLMs to interact with web pages through structured accessibility snapshots — no screenshots or vision models required.

**Features:** 55 tools covering navigation, clicking, typing, form filling, tab management, cookie/storage control, network mocking, video/trace recording, screenshot & PDF capture, and test assertions.
**Requirements:** Node.js 18+. Launches a Chromium browser instance.
